verdict.rationale: Gmail documents automations in the form of filters that trigger actions such as labeling or forwarding, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, review, or rollback of those filters or other automations. Undo Send only retracts an individual sent message, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
